name: Tirana
tagline: Colourful capital of bunkers, cafés and mountains
summary: Tirana is Albania's colourful, fast-changing capital. Walk the huge Skanderbeg Square, go underground in the Bunk'Art bunker museums about the communist era, sip coffee in the trendy Blloku, once closed to all but party leaders, and ride the Dajti cable car up the mountain above the city.
seasonNote: Spring and autumn are pleasant; July and August are hot.
arrival: Tirana International Airport is 25 minutes from the centre.
gettingAround: Walk the centre; taxis are cheap; buses to other towns leave from the North-South terminal.
cashTip: The local money is the lek (about 100 to the euro); carry cash, as many small places do not take cards. Prices here are shown in euros.
foodTip: Tavë kosi (baked lamb in yogurt), byrek, fërgesë and raki.
buyTip: Raki, olive oil and handmade filigree.
